days.title: 义路 – 秀礼
days.morning: Night bus from Hanoi, breakfast on Tu Le sticky rice.
days.afternoon: Soak in Tu Le hot springs and admire the rice fields.
days.evening: Stay at a Thai homestay with bamboo rice and hill chicken.

days.title: 考帕山口 – 蒸糯米饭山
days.morning: Cross Khau Pha pass and watch paragliders (harvest season).
days.afternoon: Photograph Mam Xoi hill and the La Pan Tan terraces.
days.evening: Stay at an H'Mong homestay and taste smoked buffalo.

days.title: 车古娘 – 德苏平
days.morning: Chase clouds and admire the Che Cu Nha terraces.
days.afternoon: De Xu Phinh village and its horseshoe-shaped terraces.
days.evening: Folk music and corn wine with the H'Mong.

days.title: 母瀑布 – 崩良
days.morning: Mo waterfall and the pơ mu forest of Pung Luong.
days.afternoon: Stream swimming and a picnic lunch among the terraces.
days.evening: Back to Tu Le and a night in a stilt house.

days.title: 芒罗 – 义路
days.morning: Muong Lo fields – the second-largest rice bowl of the Northwest.
days.afternoon: Watch Thai xòe dance and buy Tu Le young rice flakes.
